Correct the historical rollout approval record.

Reconcile the archived rollout guide with the contemporary checked-in distribution decision. Correct each claim about approval of the exact credit cap or the post-deployment snapshot. Identify the approved predeployment target and describe the subsequent snapshot as an observation. Search the guide for every occurrence, cite the checked-in evidence, and run git diff --check. Keep this a historical documentation correction; do not authorize or perform a release.

Target #136. You are the Astra ultra orchestrator. Delegate a bounded portion to a gpt-6.2-sol developer at max effort and a separate local verification task to a second Sol max developer if useful. Use collaboration.spawn_agent with fork_turns set to none, model gpt-6.2-sol, and reasoning_effort max. Supply a self-contained child brief and wait for completion. If the built-in delegation tool cannot pin both, launch a child with codex exec -m gpt-6.2-sol -c 'model_reasoning_effort="max"' in this isolated checkout; give each child exclusive file ownership. Report which children actually ran and their checks. Keep changes focused. Verify on the checkout, use synthetic fixtures, and do not change external services or deploy. If already satisfied on the base branch, provide evidence and finish without a change.

Test a synthetic fixture with the progress bar beside stale empty-state text, then remove the bar and verify the stable empty state can complete. Preserve handling of genuinely hidden indicators. Run the focused regression and the package check; use only local fixtures.
